title: Spectrum Patch with TCLayer
description: Fixes severe FPS drops near water caused by Spectrum's Ring of Aerial Grace performing expensive trinket checks every fluid raycast when using Trinkets Compat Layer for Accessories.
body:
# Spectrum Patch

Fixes severe FPS drops near water caused by Spectrum's Ring of Aerial Grace performing expensive trinket checks every fluid raycast when pairing with [Trinkets Compat Layer for Accessories](https://modrinth.com/project/TkWgV1AW).

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader
- Spectrum

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader
2. Place the mod `.jar` into your `mods` folder
3. Launch the game
